## File: facebookresearch_torchdim/third_party/functorch/examples/maml_omniglot/support/omniglot_loaders.py

Prompts

```
['create an Omniglot dataset instance with transforms and download the dataset automatically', 'create an OmniglotNShot loader for n-way k-shot few-shot learning with configurable batch size', 'test the find_classes function to discover all PNG files in a directory tree', 'test the index_classes function to map class names to integer indices', 'review the OmniglotNShot load_data_cache method that preloads batches of support and query sets']
```

